---
Title: Type I Error  - Misspecified without clustering
---


## Setup
```{r}
# Load Libraries
library(Hmisc)
library(arrow)
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(furrr)
library(glue)
library(fs)
library(here)
library(rmsb)
```

## Load data

```{r}
set.seed(1234)

# Load full dataset
df <- read_parquet(here("2-hosp", "sim-data", "h0.parquet")) |> 
    relocate(pat_id, week, tx, y, yprev, ypprev) |> 
    mutate(y = as.integer(y),
           yprev = as.factor(yprev),
           ypprev = as.factor(ypprev)) |> 
    rename(id = pat_id) |> 
    ungroup()
```

## Simulation function

We assume 20% non-uptake, so n = 270.

```{r}
run_simulation_iteration <- function(iter_num, base_path, full_data) {
    # This function runs one full simulation iteration.
    
    # --- 1. Setup for the current iteration ---
    set.seed(123 + iter_num)
    iter_path <- file.path(base_path, glue("run_{iter_num}"))
    if (!dir.exists(iter_path)) {
        dir.create(iter_path, recursive = TRUE)
    }

    # Resample from data with no effect
    # "Re-Randomize" treatment assignment for more variability
    tx_ids <- sample(unique(full_data$id), size = 180, replace = FALSE)
    soc_ids <- sample(unique(full_data$id), size = 90, replace = FALSE)

    data_for_model <- full_data |> 
        filter(id %in% c(tx_ids, soc_ids)) |>
        mutate(
            tx = if_else(id %in% tx_ids, "1", "0")
        )
    
    rm(full_data)

    # --- 5. Save the data used for model fitting ---
    saveRDS(data_for_model, file.path(iter_path, "data_for_model.rds"))


    # --- 6. Fit the Model and Save ---

    # we'll stick to evaluating type I error rate via OR of tx for the time being, then we don't need to marginalize
    
    if (nrow(data_for_model) > 0) {
        cmdstanr::set_cmdstan_path("/home/ubuntu/cmdstan")

        options(rmsbdir=iter_path) # for cmd need to save commpiled code to disk. 

        options(mc.cores = 1)
        model <- tryCatch({        
            blrm(
                    formula = y  ~ tx + rcs(week, 4) + yprev + ypprev + week %ia% yprev + week %ia% ypprev,
                    data = data_for_model,
                    refresh = 0,
                    iter = 2000,
                    chains = 4,
                    seed = 1234,
                    loo = FALSE,
                    method = "sampling",
                    backend = "cmdstan"
                )
        }, error = function(e) {
            message(glue("ERROR in iteration {iter_num}: {e$message}"))
            saveRDS(data_for_model, file.path(iter_path, "problematic_data.rds"))
            
            return(NULL)
        }, finally = {
        message(glue("Cleaning up files for iteration {iter_num}..."))
        
        # Define the full path to the temporary file
        file_to_delete <- file.path(iter_path, "lrmconppo")
        
        # Check if the file exists, then delete it
        if (file.exists(file_to_delete)) {
            unlink(file_to_delete)
        }
    })
        
        # --- 7. Save the results ONLY if the model ran successfully ---
        if (!is.null(model)) {
            # Don't save the full model object (it's too large)
            # saveRDS(model, file.path(iter_path, "model_object.rds"))
            
            # Save just the MCMC draws to a separate file
            # we actually need to the full model object for marginalization
            saveRDS(as.data.table(model$draws), file.path(iter_path, "model_draws.rds"))

            rhat_values <- model$diagnostics$summary  |> 
                select(variable, rhat) |> 
                pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = rhat) |> 
                data.frame()

            saveRDS(rhat_values, file.path(iter_path, "rhat_values.rds"))

            ess_ratios <- model$diagnostics$summary |> 
                select(variable, ess_bulk) |> 
                pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = ess_bulk) |> 
                mutate_all(~ . / (model$iter * model$chains))

             saveRDS(ess_ratios, file.path(iter_path, "ess_ratios.rds"))

             saveRDS(model$diagnostics, file.path(iter_path, "model_diagnostics.rds"))
        }
    }
    # Return a status message for progress tracking
    return(glue("Iteration {iter_num} completed."))
}
```

## Run Parallelized Simulation
```{r}
N_SIMULATIONS <- 1000
OUTPUT_PATH <- here("2-hosp", "output", "sim-H0-misspec")
N_CORES <- 28

message("Checking for previously completed simulation runs...")

completed_files <- fs::dir_ls(path = OUTPUT_PATH, glob = "*/model_draws.rds", recurse = TRUE)

completed_iters <- integer(0) 
if (length(completed_files) > 0) {
    completed_iters <- stringr::str_extract(completed_files, "(?<=run_)\\d+") |>
        as.integer() |>
        na.omit() |>
        unique()
}

# Determine which iterations still need to be run
all_possible_iters <- 1:N_SIMULATIONS
iters_to_run <- setdiff(all_possible_iters, completed_iters)

n_to_run <- length(iters_to_run)
n_completed <- length(completed_iters)

message(glue("{n_completed} of {N_SIMULATIONS} iterations are already complete."))
t1 <- Sys.time()
if (n_to_run > 0) {
    message(glue("Starting {n_to_run} new simulations on {N_CORES} cores..."))
    
    future::plan(future.callr::callr, workers = N_CORES)
    
    # --- Run Simulations in Parallel ---
    furrr::future_walk(
        .x = iters_to_run,
        .f = ~run_simulation_iteration(
            iter_num = .x,
            base_path = OUTPUT_PATH,
            full_data = df
        ),
        .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE, packages = "rmsb"),
        .progress = FALSE
    )
    
    message(glue("Finished {n_to_run} simulations."))
} else {
    message("All simulations were already complete. No new runs started.")
}
t2 <- Sys.time()

message("Simulation process finished.")
#Duration of Simulation
t2-t1
```
